description: Every tracked dependency lockfile or manifest that security-scan.yml's osv-scanner job scans. A lockfile entry without a parser lets OSV-Scanner infer it from the file name; parser names the OSV-Scanner v2 extractor for names it cannot infer (--lockfile=<parser>:<path>). A covered_by_lockfile entry is a manifest OSV-Scanner v2.6.0 has no source extractor for; its sibling lockfile is scanned instead. An excluded entry is a tracked lockfile deliberately left out of the scan; it needs a reason and an evidence path. Permitted exclusions are deliberately vulnerable test fixtures and captured native resolver or probe inputs retained with original hash/command evidence that no shipped installation recipe consumes. Captured inputs may retain unused platform or historical dependency branches; they do not qualify a runtime or grant an advisory exception. Every active installation lock and frozen application lock remains scanned. A lockfile entry that names a config is scanned in an invocation of its own under that config alone (an explicit --config applies to every input of one invocation), and every other entry together under .github/osv-scanner.toml; the tests bind each such config to its one lock. tests/test_osv_lockfile_coverage.py fails when a tracked lockfile or manifest is in none of the three lists.
